title: Briefing for 2026-10-18
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-10-18: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year. Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all. Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done. U.S. Treasury dismisses IMF debt warning and 'messy' forecasting. Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge. China indicates rare earths will keep flowing to EU, regardless of U.S. trade deal expiration.
global: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,000 arrested after protests. Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies. European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank. Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat. Watch: Did Tesla really just unveil a flying car?. I find it quite demoralising in store - why I do all my shopping online.
philippines: Rappler’s Gelo Gonzales named 2026 East-West Center Jefferson Fellow. Filipino composer Rom Dongeto and the song we thought we knew. As Asia grays, can an aging Philippines avoid its neighbors’ fate?. Why every audience vote matters in PETA’s ‘Gen G’ play.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
